title: 第1578章 突破第1577章 战
lines: 突破！
是的。
叶欢突破了，他的身上，各种光芒闪耀，神秘的能量从体内爆发出来。
伴生翼族的血脉之力，终于冲破了叶欢的屏障，光芒射向苍穹，冲破云霄，照射大地，叶欢沐浴在神光之中。
“这，这是他要突破了，难道他要渡劫了？”
众人震动，有渡劫强者惊呼。
“不！不是渡劫！”
“这是入圣！！”
众人大声呼喊，声音都几乎嘶哑了。
这声音，犹如洪钟大吕一般，响彻九霄大陆，天地人间！
众人身躯狂震，无比地震动。
入圣。
比起渡劫强者，足足低了一个大境界。
但是却让众人，更加的惊讶，可以说是无以复加。
这就意味着。
这人族叶欢，竟然是以线条九层的境界，在对战数百入圣巅峰的强者。
这，这是神王子嗣吗？还是魔尊血脉？
太，太逆天了！
此刻。
叶欢沐浴在金光色的光芒之中，身上一个个古老的文字浮现，形成了奇特的铭文之力，将他包裹，交织。
这是明显突破入圣的景象。
接下来。
便是凝聚圣纹了！
越是强大的武者，越是惊才艳艳的天骄，圣纹便越多。
众人目光都盯着叶欢，心神震动，想要看看，这人族叶欢，到底能够凝结出几道圣纹。
铭文不断浮现，古老的文字旋转，发出恐怖的大道之力，天地一片洪荒。
“这么多恐怖的符文，以这个家伙的逆天，难道他要和那轩辕城一般，凝结出十七道圣纹，亦或者是……十八道圣纹？”
十八道圣纹！
那是何等难以想象的事情啊，何等的恐怖！
然而。
叶欢此刻身上的光芒，却陡然冲破了云霄，金光闪耀，刺破苍宇。
金黄色的圣纹，终于在叶欢身上浮现。
众人冷眼看着。
此刻，叶欢有圣纹之力的宝物，是防御最强大的时候，但是一旦圣纹凝结完毕，他会出现一个虚弱期。
content_en:
breakthrough!
Yes.
Ye Huan made a breakthrough. All kinds of rays of light shone on his body, and mysterious energy burst out from his body.
The blood power of the Companion Wing Clan finally broke through Ye Huan's barrier. The light shot into the sky, broke through the clouds, and illuminated the earth. Ye Huan was bathed in the divine light.
"This, this is his breakthrough. Is he going to overcome the tribulation?"
Everyone was shocked, and some strong men who had overcome the tribulation exclaimed.
"No! It's not the Tribulation!"
"This is sanctification!!"
Everyone shouted loudly, their voices almost hoarse.
This voice, like a bell like a bell, resounds throughout the Jiuxiao Continent, heaven and earth!
Everyone's bodies shook wildly, and the ground shook incomparably.
Become a saint.
Compared with those who have overcome the tribulation, it is a whole level lower.
But it made everyone even more surprised, it can be said that it couldn't be more surprising.
This means.
This human Ye Huan was actually at the ninth level of line fighting against hundreds of experts who had reached the pinnacle of sainthood.
This, is this the heir of the God Prince? Or the bloodline of the Demon Lord?
It’s so, so outrageous!
now.
Ye Huan was bathed in the golden light, and the ancient words on his body emerged one by one, forming a strange power of inscriptions, wrapping and interweaving him.
This is a clear breakthrough into the holy scene.
Next.
It’s about condensing the holy patterns!
The more powerful the warrior is, the more amazing and talented the genius is, the more sacred marks he will have.
Everyone's eyes were fixed on Ye Huan, their hearts were shaken, and they wanted to see how many sacred patterns this human Ye Huan could condense.
Inscriptions continue to emerge, and the ancient words rotate, emitting the terrifying power of the avenue, and the world is in chaos.
"With so many terrifying runes, with this guy's ability to defy the heavens, is he going to condense seventeen holy patterns like that of Xuanyuan City, or... eighteen holy patterns?"
Eighteen sacred patterns!
What an unimaginable thing that is, how terrifying!
"Boom!"
However.
The light on Ye Huan's body suddenly broke through the sky at this moment, and the golden light shone, piercing the sky.
The golden sacred pattern finally appeared on Ye Huan's body.
Everyone looked on coldly.
At this moment, Ye Huan has a treasure with the power of the holy pattern, which is when his defense is the most powerful, but once the holy pattern is condensed, he will have a period of weakness.
